places.name: QuarantinedLots
places.description: Sonaflozin lots awaiting formal Quality sign-off; each uncoloured token is one lot.

places.name: QualitySignoffs
places.description: External, lot-specific formal Quality sign-offs. The model treats one token as a single-use approval event for one lot; how a sign-off is generated is outside this fragment.

places.name: ProductionReadyLots
places.description: Sonaflozin lots formally released from quarantine and available to move to production; each token is one lot.

transitions.name: Formal Quality Release
transitions.description: Moves one Sonaflozin lot from quarantine to production-ready stock using one external lot-specific Quality sign-off. This static fragment does not model review duration or how Quality creates the sign-off.
